df.dtypes
# order_id        int64

caption: Dates arrive as text (object) unless you ask.

eyebrow: CSV · when the file is messy
code:
pd.read_csv(
    "messy.csv",
    sep=";",          # delimiter
    decimal=",",      # 1,5 -> 1.5
    na_values=["N/A", "-"],
    usecols=["id", "amount"],
    nrows=1000)
caption: Also: dtype={...}, parse_dates=[...].

code:
# pip install openpyxl
df = pd.read_excel("orders.xlsx",
                   sheet_name="Orders")

with pd.ExcelWriter("report.xlsx") as w:
    df.to_excel(w, sheet_name="Orders",
                index=False)
caption: sheet_name=None returns every sheet in a dict.
Missing values are written as null.
